## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: graduated licensing and restrictions
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Level Two supervision: the page says a supervising driver must be seated beside the driver, which this dossier applies to driving outside the unsupervised hours, matching the unsupervised-driving bullets on the same page [A02] (verify NC-GDL-D-SUP).
Exact numbers are kept as printed: 30 classroom hours, six behind-the-wheel hours, 60 log hours with 10 at night, and nine months at Level One [A01].
The federal-identification date of May 7, 2025 is a policy date and is isolated as dynamic [A04].
Required-document tables that follow this page are out of scope for the knowledge test and were not mapped.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: Level Two page lists the supervising driver seated beside the driver without saying when; dossier applies it to driving outside the unsupervised hours.
